missing_elements: Impacted Repositories: The spec describes changes to openshift/api (API extension) and the operator repo (controller changes) but does not explicitly list both repository URLs as a separate inventory. The reader must infer the repo split from the Implementation Details and API Extensions sections.

quality_issues.quote: the platform is left to choose a reasonable default, which is subject to change over time
quality_issues.suggestion: The spec resolves this in the Implementation Details section (120 seconds / 2 minutes), but the API doc comment itself is intentionally vague. This is acceptable for API conventions but could confuse an implementer reading only the types. Consider adding an implementation note cross-referencing the default.

The upgrade table shows requiresRepublish changing from nil to true. The spec explains this is safe because rotation was already enabled via DaemonSet args, but this is technically a behavioral change — kubelet will now call NodePublishVolume periodically where it did not before. The spec should explicitly acknowledge this is a net-new kubelet behavior being introduced on upgrade, even though the driver already handled rotation internally.

quality_issues.quote: Risk: Setting minimumRefreshAge too low could overwhelm the external secret provider with API calls. Mitigation: OpenShift document will suggest users to choose a wise value.
quality_issues.suggestion: The mitigation is documentation-only. Consider adding a non-blocker recommendation: the minimum value of 1 second combined with kubelet syncFrequency might still generate significant load. The spec already notes 'Setting this value below the kubelet syncFrequency (default: 1 minute) has no additional effect' which is good, but the risk/mitigation could reference this built-in floor.

non_blockers: Explicit repository inventory (openshift/api + secrets-store-csi-driver-operator) would improve implementer onboarding
The requiresRepublish nil→true upgrade change should more explicitly acknowledge the new kubelet NodePublishVolume call behavior
Risk mitigation for low minimumRefreshAge could reference the kubelet syncFrequency floor already documented in the field description
